headline: Last session: Indian markets recovered as Sensex ended over 300 points higher, Nifty near 23,150

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 28 September.

why: On the last trading day, Sensex ended over 300 points higher as Indian markets recovered from Thursday's heavy losses.
Auto and consumer durables sector stocks gained nearly 1% during the last trading session.
Midweek market weakness was triggered by crude oil prices surging above $100 and proposed insurance restrictions.
The government cut its FY27 borrowing target by ₹1.2 trillion, planning to raise ₹7.8 trillion in H2.
whatHappening: JSW One Platforms filed draft prospectus to raise ₹3,054 crore through an initial public offering.
Zee sought action against Reliance-Disney's JioStar alleging breach of copyright.
Government sources revealed financial bids for IDBI Bank's strategic sale are currently under evaluation.
The government is considering mandatory blending of imported coal at power plants.
summary:
On the last trading session, Indian markets rebounded with the Sensex rising over 300 points and Nifty nearing 23,150.
Auto and consumer durable sectors led the recovery following a sharp midweek sell-off caused by rising oil prices.
Major corporate developments include JSW One Platforms filing IPO papers and ongoing evaluations for IDBI Bank's strategic sale.
